artifacts/model.pk.description: Random-forest regressor (scikit-learn 0.22.2 pickle, 100 trees, 133 features) predicting thermal conductivity from Magpie composition features

instance.description: Predict the thermal conductivity of a single chemical composition from its Magpie elemental-property features.

composition.description: Chemical formula, e.g. "Bi2Te3" or "Ag9 Tl1 Te5"

thermal_conductivity.description: Predicted thermal conductivity, kappa (W m^-1 K^-1)

imputed_features.description: Number of features unavailable for this composition and replaced by training-set means (0 = none; non-zero predictions are less reliable)

dataset.description: Batch-predict thermal conductivity for many compositions from a CSV with a 'composition' column. Produces a predictions CSV and a histogram of the predicted values.

file.description: CSV file with a 'composition' column of chemical formulas; other columns are passed through

predictions.csv.description: The input rows with kappa_pred (W m^-1 K^-1), imputed_features and error columns appended

predictions_hist.png.description: Histogram of the predicted thermal conductivities
